item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello there, Stonewood. Welcome to the SCP Wiki!

Glad to see after some time of being interested in the topic, you've found yourself interested in writing an SCP of your own. Seeing that you're very interested in writing, I highly suggest that you check out our IRC Chatrooms where you can talk to other members of the community regarding things that interest you. Anyway, here are some resources to help you out around the site:

◎ Open Resources ◎
◉ Close Resources ◉

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts.

Sandbox

For hashing out concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by the community if you need help refining your concept.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out our Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular, recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community.

With that said, I hope you enjoy your time here.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Greetings Foundation peoples!

I have been following SCP's for a very long time and have finally decided that I would like to contribute. For the most part I've just been lurking on the forums and viewing SCP content on Youtube but the creative juices have begun to flow and I must write them down somewhere! A lot of my hobbies involve creative writing (D&D, Hobby Game Design, Etc.) and this seems like a wonderful community to contribute to. Thank you all for leaving the door open for new members to join and the resources and guidance I've already had on IRC and other places. I look forward to my time on this site!

Best,

The Archivist.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello all.

I have never really tried for a community before so I am very happy being here, and thankful to you for having me. I am really looking forward to reading and writing for one of the best worlds ever created in fiction. I absolutely love the concept of the SCP universe and can't wait to be apart of it.

As for random thoughts that keep me up at night, I guess I have a very busy mind, too busy I suppose, most nights I'd just pace up and down my room thinking of stories I'll never write.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone,
I've been here reading for years now, but never built up the courage to actually join the community.
I'm currently working as a researcher in cognitive and behavioral neurophysiology, but I also moonlighted for a few years after high school as a playwright for local theaters. I sincerely hope that I can correctly mix my two writing sides, scientific and creative, in order to create something attractive and interesting. I already have some ideas, developed throughout the years, but, of course, quite a bit scared of community reactions.
As for what kind of random thoughts keeps me up at night, the answer is probably "stories", in the broadest and most general sense. I am enamored with stories so I spend hours thinking and ruminating fictional character and events. In a sense, it's like candy for my brain.
I sincerely hope to get immersed in the community. It's nice to be here, finally.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hey there! I go by "DrStinkyBacteriaV2" in tribute to my previous wikidot account "DrStinkyBacteria" which I have not accessed in over 2 years now. I've been into the SCP genre for over 3 years now and I have finally taken it upon myself to begin fantasizing on several ideas I have loathed over. But, I'm truly getting ahead of myself.

The real reason I finally decide to revive my previous wikidot account is because, well, I had written an entire SCP on the SCP Wiki Sandbox and never did anything with it; how foolish of me to allow such fantastic ideas go to waste, right? Anyways the ideas had some merit to them and I thought I'd revive them along with a set goal to have a long-standing within this genre.

But anyways, I currently have nothing better to do with my life, especially consider that it is Christmas Break for me at the moment, and Covid is giving me quite a bit of free time to say the least. I am quite frankly excited to get to encounter new people and I am also looking forward to endlessly typing on this site. Right now living in a tiny as hell duplex In-the-Middle-of-Nowhere, Tennessee and I'd say that I am having the time of my life, with my introverted self, at this computer.

Sorry for any grammar mistakes this may have, I have been up all night and I am writing this now at 3:35 AM.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Hi there! I'm Gattebara, any pronouns, live in the Buryatia Republic, in Russia. I've known about the Foundation a long time ago, last year I joined the Russian branch, and now I've entered the original site. My purposes here are reading, voting and translation activity, I'm not a very good writer.

I am a huge fan of the Foundation, and reading some Sarkicism articles literally made me a leftist pro-feminist and defined many character traits and interests in me, uh oh. Well, maybe not so directly.

my other interests, although i don't think it's important: history, culture of other nations, various religions, young-adult books, music and She-Ra.

a random thought keep me up at night: why there are only two islands around Tallinn, but a lot of them near Helsinki….

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded: Hello everyone, I go by the username yitsu. I first discovered the SCP Foundation on YouTube and was instantly hooked. I would watch any other SCP videos that would show up on my YouTube page. Eventually, I wondered where the information about these SCP's was shared and found out about the SCP Foundation Wiki page. There were so many SCP's than I originally thought there were. I am interested in writing my own SCP's for the foundation. I just really enjoy reading about different unique SCP's and also interested in writing some of my own.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hey DashDotBlank, and welcome to the site! Always great to welcome a long time fan to the ranks of members here. I like your attitude towards all this, and it's definitely a process to get an idea critiqued and reviewed before being able to even get to the drafting phase. With those kind of themes, I think youll fit in just fine. As well as good taste in games, enjoy the gaming. Take your time and get acquainted with how everything here works, and make sure to check out IRC chat too!

For my recommendation, you should check out SCP-5545

+ Resources
- Hide Resources

For posting ideas, make sure you go through the proper greenlighting process on the idea forums first. Remember that there is no rush, and you should take time familiarizing yourself with how Series 6 articles are formatted. We are a rather unique bunch so I'm sure just reading and being a part of the community will be rather fun for you!

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts.

Sandbox

For hashing out concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by the community if you need help refining your concept.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out our Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular, recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community.


Best of luck!
